design.caption: The same colorful Chinese dragon dance procession moving down the same crowded traditional street. Preserve the dragon head, large eyes, cloth body, handlers, banners, crowd, buildings and daylight. Keep the source video style and source action; no scene cuts.
design.coordinate_semantics: Source-camera-relative offset divided by source-specific depth radius; negative Y is up. Source fitted motion retained. Independently authored path, no author trajectory copied.
design.framing_revision: Keep the procession-side crane path; anchor and scale on the bright foreground dragon head rather than the trailing cloth/crowd centroid.
design.foreground_proxy: Source head-region pixel brightness/depth ROI; approximate composition proxy, not semantic labels
